name: Digital Compression Testing Machine 2000 kN
short_description: Heavy-duty 2000 kN digital compression testing machine with microprocessor pace rate controller and peak load retention for concrete cube and cylinder testing.
description: The **Accurion ACC-CTM-2000D Digital Compression Testing Machine** is a four-pillar high-stiffness frame engineered for compressive strength determination of standard 150 mm concrete cubes and 150 x 300 mm cylinders in accordance with **IS 516** and **BS EN 12390-4**.

key_features.feature: Microprocessor digital indicator with peak load hold and pace rate bar graph
Measurement accuracy within ±1% from 10% to 100% of full capacity
Hydraulic overload protection with automatic ram travel limit switch
Hardened self-aligning spherical seated upper platen

seo_title: Digital Compression Testing Machine 2000 kN | Accurion Technologies
seo_description: 2000 kN digital concrete compression testing machine (CTM) manufactured per IS 516. Features high-stiffness frame, peak load hold, and NABL calibration.
